hypothesis: One latent preparation/workload memory plus observed AP; separate effective idle reference from residual preparation heat. Diagnostic linear state, not identified internal temperature or ambient.

global_fit.gamma: one nonnegative least-squares coefficient conditional on tau; no grid/gain cap or post-evaluation refit
global_fit.loss: post-load AP MSE; tie smaller tau
global_fit.meaning: prespecified finite diagnostic search, not physical range

per_session_initialization: Use only existing >=55 second pre-load AP, fit E and H at first pre-load sample by rank-checked linear least squares; anchor observed T at last pre-load sample, propagate H and remaining idle without future AP. No required ambient value.
data_role: All five sessions previously seen. One posthoc development, four parameter-fit-excluded posthoc evaluations; fresh independent sessions zero.
identifiability: Report scaled singular values/condition, full tau profile, boundary optimum and ±0.05C hypothetical pre-load rounding sensitivity. Profile within best RMSE+0.05C is a sensitivity set, not CI or acceptance criterion. Rank deficient -> null.
adoption: No automatic default/strict/policy-cost promotion; accuracy_pass null. Do not try another candidate family if this one fails.
thermal_service: Archived COLLECT05 completed development3+confirmation1; match last AP whose read ended before invocation within 10 seconds. Stratify session x state-block x task-backend x actual inference overlap. Show within-stratum AP and elapsed associations, not causal throttle coefficient; unmatched samples excluded with denominator. No thermal curve fit.
